name: tokenis
description: Ask aggregate questions about confidential data without exposing a single record.
long_description: Tokenis serves a dataset to Claude as a few aggregate tools over encrypted columns. Groups smaller than k records are refused, queries that would combine to isolate a record are refused, every call is budgeted per user, and every answer and refusal is written to a signed audit trail. Leave the config empty to try it on built-in fictional data.

tools.name: describe_dataset
tools.description: Columns, filterable values, minimum group size and remaining budget

tools.name: aggregate
tools.description: Sum, average or count of a sealed column over filtered records

tools.name: group_by
tools.description: The same, per value of a filterable column; small groups suppressed

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Direction and ratio band between two sealed columns

tools.name: similarity_search
tools.description: Entities most similar to a given one, as tokens

tools.name: exists
tools.description: Whether at least k records match

tools.name: disclose_ratio
tools.description: Audited ratio of two group totals, for a configured purpose

tools.name: disclose_bucket
tools.description: Audited bucket label for a group total, for a configured purpose

config_file.title: Tokenis config (tokenis.toml)
config_file.description: Your dataset and policy. Leave empty for the built-in fictional demo data.

tokenizer_key.title: Tokenizer key
tokenizer_key.description: 64 hex characters from `tokenis-mcp keygen-secret`; needed with a config file.

audit_key.title: Audit-trail signing key
audit_key.description: 64 hex characters, if the config sets [state] audit_key_env.
